skill.name: seo-keyword-strategist
skill.description: Analyzes keyword usage in provided content, calculates density, suggests semantic variations and LSI keywords based on the topic. Prevents over-optimization. Use PROACTIVELY for content optimization.
skill.summary: Reviews content for keyword density, semantic coverage, and natural SEO optimization opportunities.
skill.author: sickn33

content.value_statement: Content teams need keyword guidance that improves relevance without stuffing. This skill reviews content, maps entities, and suggests natural keyword placement.
actual_capabilities: Identifies primary and secondary keywords from supplied content.
Calculates keyword density and flags likely overuse.
Suggests semantic variations and related LSI keywords.
Maps related entities and topical concepts for content depth.
Assesses likely search intent from the content type.
Creates keyword placement and optimization checklists.
limitations: It does not fetch live keyword volume or ranking data.
It depends on the content and topic details provided by the user.
It does not replace dedicated SEO crawlers or analytics tools.
Its recommendations should be validated against brand and compliance rules.

use_cases.title: Refresh Existing Blog Content
use_cases.description: Review a draft or published article for keyword gaps, entity coverage, and natural placement opportunities.

use_cases.title: Plan Topic Cluster Pages
use_cases.description: Build keyword clusters, related entities, and supporting subtopics for a new content hub.

use_cases.title: Check Product Page Copy
use_cases.description: Find over-optimized phrases and add semantic variations before product content goes live.

prompt_templates.title: Analyze Keyword Density
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze this content for the primary keyword "[keyword]". Calculate density, flag overuse, and suggest natural placement improvements.

prompt_templates.title: Generate Semantic Variations
prompt_templates.scenario: Expand a topic with related terms
prompt_templates.prompt: For the topic "[topic]", suggest secondary keywords, LSI terms, related entities, and question-based phrases for a natural SEO brief.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Optimization Checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this page copy for search intent, keyword distribution, entity coverage, and over-optimization. Return a prioritized optimization checklist.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Topic Cluster Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning for a content hub
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a keyword cluster strategy for "[core topic]". Include pillar terms, supporting pages, entity groups, intent types, and internal linking ideas.

output_examples.input: Analyze a 1,200 word article targeting "email marketing automation".
output_examples.output: The primary keyword appears 14 times for about 1.2 percent density. Add variations such as automated email workflows, lifecycle campaigns, and trigger-based messaging.

output_examples.input: Create semantic keyword ideas for a page about project management software.
output: Secondary keywords: task tracking, team collaboration, resource planning.
Entities: Kanban boards, timelines, workload management, project templates.
Questions: What features matter in project management software?

output_examples.input: Check product copy for keyword stuffing.
output_examples.output: The phrase repeats in adjacent headings and body paragraphs. Replace some uses with natural variants and move one mention into image alt text.

best_practices: Provide the target keyword, page type, audience, and full content when possible.
Ask for density, intent, entities, and placement recommendations in one review.
Validate suggested terms against real search data before final publication.
anti_patterns: Do not force every suggested keyword into the same paragraph.
Do not treat density targets as fixed rules for every topic.
Do not optimize without checking readability and search intent.

faq.question: Does this skill perform live keyword research?
faq.answer: No. It works from provided content and topic context, not live search volume or ranking data.

faq.question: Can it help prevent keyword stuffing?
faq.answer: Yes. It flags repeated terms and suggests natural semantic variations.

faq.question: Does it support Claude, Codex, and Claude Code?
faq.answer: Yes. The marketplace metadata lists Claude, Codex, and Claude Code as supported tools.

faq.question: What inputs produce the best results?
faq.answer: Share the content, target keyword, audience, page type, and any SEO constraints.

faq.question: Can it create an SEO brief?
faq.answer: Yes. It can outline keywords, related entities, search intent, and optimization tasks.

faq.question: Should I publish its suggestions directly?
faq.answer: Review every suggestion for accuracy, brand fit, readability, and compliance before publishing.
